title: A computational protocol and software implementation \(as a MATLAB application) for biomarker identification in infrared spectroscopy datasets
protocol: Download and extract the “bmtool.zip” file to a folder of choice.
Start MATLAB.
Add the “lib” folder to your MATLAB path.
Start MATLAB and change the current directory to the “work” folder created upon installation.
At the MATLAB command prompt, type “bmtool”.
In the “(1) Select input dataset” panel, click on the “Load…” button.
Locate the desired file by clicking “List files below”.
Make sure the “Agent vs. vehicle control (VC)” radio button is selected in the “(2) Mount datasets for analysis” panel.
Inform the index of the class that corresponds to the reference class (VC) in your dataset.
Click on "Mount datasets".
Generate 2-class datasets by combining VC data with each remaining class.
Select desired datasets in the "(\(3)) Select mounted datasets" panel or press "Select all".
Tick the “BM1 …”, “BM2 …” and “BM3 …” checkboxes in the "(\(4)) Run session" panel.
Set recommended values for BM2: “Number of variables”: 1; “k for k-fold cross-validation”: 10.
Set recommended values for BM3: “Top number of variables”: 3; “Number of bootstraps”: 500.
Press the "Run!" button to generate results.
Select which results you want to visualize in the "(\(5)) Manipulate results" panel or press "Select all".
Choose the type of visualization that you want to generate.
Select "Mixed: BM curves" from the visualization options and click on "Visualize!".
Select "Mixed: Biomarker-localization plots" from the visualization options and click on "Visualize!".
Select "Biomarker-localization report" and click on "Visualize!".
